## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- **No inline CSS:** the `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.
- **Class/ID selectors only:** every design property, layout rule, and state must be targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`.
- **Minimal HTML modifications:** HTML must stay clean, semantic, and styling-agnostic — changing the site's entire look must require editing only `style.css`.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
- Store all tokens in `:root` (light) and override in the dark scope. Required tokens: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success` (values in 0.2), plus:
- `--radius-sm: 2px`, `--radius-md: 6px`, `--radius-lg: 10px` (industrial crispness); `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`; `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem` (plus a fluid section rhythm token, e.g., `--spacing-section: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 7rem)`); `--transition-fast: 120ms`, `--transition-normal: 240ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1)`; `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 1000`, `--z-toast: 1100`.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Dark mode **must always be defined**: base dark tokens via `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` plus explicit `[data-theme="dark"]` / `[data-theme="light"]` overrides so switching requires no HTML restructuring.
- **Persistence:** store the user's choice in `localStorage`; on first visit with no stored value, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`. The Light theme is the canonical, reference design and must be fully polished first; the Dark theme must be equally complete.
- **Toggle control:** visible theme toggle (Material Symbols `dark_mode`/`light_mode`) with correct `aria-pressed` and dynamically updated `aria-label` ("Switch to dark theme" / "Switch to light theme").

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layout structure with **Flexbox**.
- **Default alignment rule:** every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (e.g., top-aligned text stacks inside cards).
- **Mobile-friendly first:** all flex layouts must be responsive out of the box — rows convert to columns at breakpoints, no horizontal scrolling at any width from 320px up.

**1.5 Styling Approach & Tailwind Integration**
- Use clean, utility-disciplined custom CSS in `style.css` (Tailwind `@layer`/`@apply` mindset, no build step). If you include Tailwind via its Play CDN, every utility must resolve to the CSS variables above. Either way, generic reusable classes — `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.container`, `.section` — are mandatory, and all colors/sizes must reference `var(--...)`.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- All text fonts come from Google Fonts and bind to `--font-base` / `--font-display` / `--font-mono` (0.3). All icons come from Google Material Symbols (0.4). Decorative circuit motifs must be **CSS-drawn** (borders, gradients, pseudo-elements) — never inline SVG or image files.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--secondary`, `.btn--danger`)**
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px, `--radius-sm`, `--font-base`.
- **Hover:** visible brightness/shadow shift plus `transform: translateY(-2px)`, `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** distinct `:focus-visible` ring built from CSS variables (`outline`/`box-shadow`) for keyboard navigation.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` click feedback.
- **Loading (`.is-loading`):** interaction blocked (double-click prevention), rotating `progress_activity` Material Symbol spinner rendered **without changing button dimensions**.
- **Disabled (`.is-disabled` / `disabled`):** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** temporary feedback classes driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error` + `--border-success` / `--border-error`, never color-only (pair with an icon or text change).
- `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in **both** light and dark themes. Anchor-styled buttons share the same class system.

**2.2 Card Component (`.card`, used by Features, Testimonials, Pricing)**
- **Default:** flexible Flexbox layout (column stack inside), `--bg-secondary` surface, 1px `--border-default`, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-sm`.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` + `--shadow-md` + border brightening.
- **Focus-within:** card border highlights when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (skeleton):** define `.card--skeleton` with a CSS shimmer `@keyframes` animation that preserves layout dimensions.
- **Empty state:** define `.card--empty` — structured fallback with a Google Icon and clear guidance text.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements (`.input-group` — used by the Final CTA email capture)**
- **Structure:** flex container wrapping a `<label>`, the input field, and a dedicated error-feedback container (with `aria-live="polite"`).
- **States — all styled via classes:** Empty, Focused (outline ring via variables), Filled, Valid (success border + `check` icon), Invalid (error border, `--text-error` message, `error` icon — never color-only), Disabled, Read-only.

**2.4 Modal / Popup (Hero "Watch the Demo" modal)**
- **States:** Opening (fade + subtle scale via `--transition-normal`), Open, Loading (spinner state while the demo initializes), Error fallback (icon + retry message), Closing (reverse animation). All animation is CSS-driven.
- **UX/a11y features:** centered flex overlay (`align-items: center`) with dimmed backdrop; Google Material Symbol `close` icon button (min 44×44px); keyboard focus trap; close via `Esc` and overlay click; `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`; focus returns to the trigger on close; body scroll locked while open; use `--z-modal`.
- **Content:** a CSS-animated logic-gate/truth-table visual (mono-font `0|1` bits, pulsing traces) — all decorative parts `aria-hidden="true"`.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default:** fluid type/spacing via `clamp()`; breakpoints via flex-wrap and media queries; zero horizontal overflow from 320px up.
- **Smooth animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal)` on all state changes; a `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block disables transforms, animations, and transitions.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast in **both** modes; never rely on color alone to communicate state; semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`), one `h1`, logical heading order; a "Skip to content" link; full keyboard operability (nav menu, accordion, modal, toggle, form) with no mouse-only interactions; logical DOM/focus order; `aria-current` on active nav links; `aria-live` regions for form feedback and loading states.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes (define it even if unused on this page).
- **Navigation UX:** sticky header; anchor links smooth-scroll (`scroll-behavior: smooth` + `scroll-margin-top` matching header height).
- **Hover effects (theme signature):** nav links (color shift + underline slide), buttons, feature/testimonial/pricing cards, FAQ chevron rotation, footer link underline slide.
